source_authority.incident_summary: 'Silent skip on uncertainty' institutionalised as design: /sc:brainstorm 'If uncertain, do NOT trigger. False negatives preferred over token waste' (A9:F-A9-002); a Stage-9 ambiguity check resolved the uncertain case as already-found (fail-open ambiguous=found, A2a:F-A2a-008). R1.6 made gates fail-closed. Contract #5 forbids return-True fragility/false-negative-preferred stubs.

pre_fix_snippet: return True  # fail-open: if uncertain treat as found — false negatives preferred for now
expected_contract_5_invariant: MUST FAIL pre-fix (a fail-open-on-uncertainty `return True # ... for now` stub is matched by the Contract #5 fragility-stub regex — uncertainty silently converted to a pass), MUST PASS post-fix (R1.6 made gates fail-closed; the live src/superclaude/cli tree contains ZERO fail-open fragility stubs, and the companion deterministic ambiguous/validation gates return False on uncertain input).
